title: NHM Thiruvananthapuram Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Public Relations Officer Posts
description: National Health Mission (NHM Thiruvananthapuram) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Public Relations Officer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in post-graduation, including MBA, can grab this chance and apply for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram Notification 2026 . Here, we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last date ...
